title: Skip before a program
statement: For any limit record, program, execution depth, state $\sigma$, budget $T$, statement $s$, and postcondition $Q$, if $s$ can execute from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ and end in a state satisfying $Q$, then the sequence consisting of skip followed by $s$ can also execute from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ and end in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The statement s executes from σ within budget T and ends in a state satisfying Q.
